programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: mareTV: The Blue and White Island World of Greece: Mykonos, Naxos and Tinos
programme.desc: Around the once sacred Isle of Delos, some 200 islands, including 20 larger ones, are arranged almost in a circle. This is where the name of the Greek island paradise comes from: Cyclades, a derivation of the Greek word kýklos, circle. Each cyclade has a unique character. The pelican Petros, about 20 years old, is the mascot of Mykonos. He moves from taverna to taverna all day long, scrounging fish. This works out sometimes well and sometimes not so well. Petros does have a few human friends who regularly slip him something, but all too often visitors eager to take pictures block his path. Then he has to "wiggle" his way through the crowd. Jackie Onassis is said to have once brought Petros' "great-grandmother" from Louisiana to the island.

programme.title: The Provence coast - Marseille and the Côte Bleue
programme.desc: The Provence is famed for its endless fields of laven-der, but this lush landscape also has a beautifully mari-time touch: The Côte Bleue! Small, hidden beaches, charming harbour towns, imposing, craggy bays and a uniquely clear light that has attracted painters includ-ing Cézanne and Braque. The coast derives its name from the deep blue water and extends from Marseille to Martigues. This small town is also known as "The Ven-ice of the North", as it is shaped entirely by water: an inland lake, the sea itself, as well as a connecting canal. In the bays of the Calanques, the steeply-walled coastal inlets in the Mediterranean limestone, Lionel Franc is a cliff diver. His personal record is a hight of 36 metres! Ambi is a sculptress. This young artist's work, who moved to Marseille from Madagascar many years ago, is characterised by a dynamic momentum. As a pas-sionate pétanque player, she demonstrates this drive on the boules courts of the port city. John Pendray is Pein-tre officiel de la Marine, an official marine painter. The French state allows just 40 painters to its circle. There are no monetary rewards, but heaps of honour and a very smart uniform!

programme.title: Wild & Wide Awake - From the Mediterranean to the Alps
programme.desc: The first part of the spring journey takes us from the Spanish inland to the rugged Atlantic and to the Mediterranean, through the French Provence, and finally into the Alps. Along the way, flamingos perform their bizarre dancing rituals, wild horses storm through the wetland… While the North is still covered by snow and ice, the South will soon turn into a blooming garden and every creature is enjoying the first signs of the awakening.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: Wild Baltic - Life on the Amber Coast
programme.desc: The first episode of this two-part nature documentary presents the natural beauty of the shifting sand dunes of the Curonian Spit, the romantic beaches of the Latvian Baltic Sea and the island worlds of Estonia. Time and again, this deserted and almost untouched nature fascinates. In the winter, ringed seals give birth to their young on the pack ice. In the spring, Konik wild horse stallions fight fierce battles amongst themselves, while colourful European rollers fly through the dune forests. Lynxes wander through the coastal forests and in the orchid meadows turncoats and hoopoes find more than enough food. On the islands around Saaremaa in Estonia, grey seals hunt for fish. They share the archipelago with Europe’s largest tern, the Caspian tern.

programme.title: Wild Baltic
programme.sub-title: Wild Baltic - Enchanted Forests and Moors
programme.desc: The wide, often untouched wilderness of the Baltic hinterland is home to many animals. More than 35 brown bears live in the primeval forests of Alutaguse. In the spring, the Soomaa National Park transforms into a huge lake. Europe's widest waterfall is located in Latvia. In the beginning of May, vimba bream follow the course of the River Venta. The hardly 5-centimetre-long fish have to overcome a 4-metre-long rock barrier in order to reach their spawning grounds.

programme.title: Magic Lakes
programme.desc: At 117 square kilometres, the Müritz is the largest lake on German territory, but it’s far from the only one in the north east of the country. Even the Mecklenburg Lake District, between Waren and Feldberg, contains around 2 lakes alone. Thanks to the Müritz National Park the species diversity is particularly high in the region: half of the German crane population breeds in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern; the osprey is typical of the Müritz area; the lively Eurasian otter hunts here; and the endangered red milan circles the skies above. Fred Bollmann knows the national park like hardly any other. The former ranger and voluntary nature conservationist is actively involved in the preservation of ‘his’ wildlife world. Filming for this production took two years. The outcome is a unique portrait of this stunning region.

programme.title: The Seychelles - Africa with South Seas ambience
programme.desc: The 115 islands and islets that make up the Seychelles present a breath-taking variety of plants, rare animals and beaches laced with palms. This is where the leg-endary Coco de Mer palm nuts grow with fruits weigh-ing up to 20 kilos and giant wild land turtles nibble away at mangrove fruits to their hearts content. The archipelago was first settled at the end of the 18th cen-tury. Today, a very colourful potpourri of peoples in this dwarf state proves just how peacefully different cultures can live side by side. Three times a week, the steamer "MV Espoir" completes the trip from the main island of Mahé to Praslin and back. A ship for every-one and practically everything: Used cars, toilet paper, horses, bicycles, furniture - you name it, the Espoir transports goods of all kinds. Coconuts sometimes pose a problem as there are far too many of them. What to do with them? The best place to send them is undoubt-edly Hubert Roumien's Virgin Coconut Oil Laboratory, hidden away in the Mahé jungle. Straw turns into gold at Seaweed Seychelles! There, Benjamin Port Louis collects seaweed and extracts liquid fertiliser from it.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.desc: Wildlife film-makers often risk life and limb trying to capture unique images of their dangerous protagonists. In Alaska a cunning grizzly threatens the son of Andreas Kieling, on the remote Wrangel Island in northern-east Siberia his colleague Uwe Anders is taken by surprise by a a polar bear, and off the coast of South Africa a diving-team is unexpectedly surrounded by white sharks. But the life of the film-makers is also threatened by elemental forces, life-threatening diseases and failing technical equipment: Deep in the vast rainforests of West Africa cameraman Klaus Scheurich nearly dies of malaria, and in South India a film team narrowly escapes death in a hot-air balloon accident. But they also meet remarkable people such as a zoo keeper in Cameroon who feels at ease playing with half-grown and adult gorillas - the most powerful of all great apes. The first episode "Wild Moments - Dangerous and Deadly" follows wildlife film-makers on their adventurous journeys throughout the world.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.desc: Wildlife filmmakers often risk life and limb trying to capture unique images of their dangerous protagonists. A cunning grizzly grabs a salmon off Andreas Kieling's fishing rod, in the depths of the Amazon River a diving team has a spooky encounter with piranhas, in the Mediterranean Sea the currents nearly push Thomas Behrend into the mouths of angry sperm whales defending a newborn - and cameramen who want to film jaguars in the dense jungle of South America become easy prey for the well camouflaged cats. The life of the film-makers is also threatened by elemental forces and failing technical equipment: In the swamps of North Australia violent storms hold up the crossing of tearing rivers, a volcano in the South Seas spits burning lumps of lava into the base camp, and in Siberia a camera team breaks through the ice and has to camp at minus 30°C in the middle of nowhere. The second episode "Wild Moments - Dangerous and Deadly" follows wildlife-filmmakers on their adventurous journeys throughout the world.

A cunning grizzly grabs a salmon off Andreas Kieling's fishing rod, in the depths of the Amazon River a diving team has a spooky encounter with piranhas, in the Mediterranean Sea the currents nearly push Thomas Behrend into the mouths of angry sperm whales defending a newborn - and cameramen who want to film jaguars in the dense jungle of South America become easy prey for the well camouflaged cats. The life of the film-makers is also threatened by elemental forces and failing technical equipment: In the swamps of North Australia violent storms hold up the crossing of tearing rivers, a volcano in the South Seas spits burning lumps of lava into the base camp, and in Siberia a camera team breaks through the ice and has to camp at minus 30°C in the middle of nowhere. The second episode "Wild Moments - Dangerous and Deadly" follows wildlife-filmmakers on their adventurous journeys throughout the world.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.desc: Wildlife filmmakers often risk life and limb trying to capture unique images of their dangerous protagonists. In the Kruger National Park Josef Jozefowicz steps into a lionesses' den to film her cubs, in Alaska Andreas Kieling mingles with giant elk bulls in order to film them in action, and in Florida his colleague Zoltan Török gets very close to an alligator mother guarding its nest. The life of the film-makers is also threatened by elemental forces, and failing technical equipment: the strong and tearing current of the Yukon River throws Andreas Kieling's boat onto a gravel bank, in the Democratic Republik of Congo camerawoman Heike Grebe is separated from her colleagues in the dense rainforest, in Kamchatka a film team only just escapes a gigantic landslide, and in Finland a hot-air balloon catches fire and becomes the nightmare of Oliver Goetzl and Ivo Nörenberg. The last episode "Wild Moments - Dangerous and Deadly" follows wildlife film-makers on their adventurous journeys throughout the world.

programme.title: Wild Moments
programme.desc: All over the world men and women fight for the protection of nature reserves and endangered species. This is their story, a story of bravery and stamina. We visit scientists in Central Europe who monitor the offspring of the rare lynx nearly 200 years after these elusive cats were extinct in the wild. We follow the work of the moose detective in Sweden on the island of Oland who tries to solve the riddle of increasing numbers of dead moose calves. In the heart of Africa one woman and her guards try to protect rare lowland gorillas and forest elephants but the increasing bush meat trade and the ongoing ivory smuggling makes their work extremely dangerous. Last but not least we meet US conservationists who rescue manatees in Florida - they have all dedicated their life to make a change. Without their work our world would be poorer.

programme.title: mareTV: La Palma: The Greenest of the Canaries
programme.desc: Thundering waterfalls, ancient forests and an impressive volcanic landscape with black beaches: La Palma is a dream island for nature lovers. It is by far the island of the Canary Islands with the most green, almost half of it is covered with forest. But once a year the green island is dominated by the color white. On Rosenmontag (Rose Monday), the inhabitants have for decades been targeting those ancestors who returned from abroad wealthy and ostentatiously demonstrated their wealth with powdered faces. The carnivalistic approach culminates every year in a white chaos, with tons of talcum, flour or paint trickling down the uniformly white dressed islanders. On the Roque de los Muchachos, La Palma's highest mountain at 2,400 meters, stands one of the largest reflecting telescopes in the world. Astrophysicists love the island because it is the perfect place to look into space. Researchers and star lovers look spellbound to Beteigeuze. The giant star is probably in front of a supernova and could become a second moon in the firmament.

programme.title: mareTV: Santorini - The Beauty on the Powder Keg
programme.desc: The Santorini archipelago is a gem, but is located on a veritable powder keg. It is only a matter of time before the volcano, the crater rim of which gave us this island world, erupts again. Since January 2011, threatening rumblings have been perceived beneath the archipelago. On Santorini, it's a case of getting nowhere fast without a mule. Whether the restaurant terraces above the abyss of Oia, the hotels on the breath-taking cliffs of Imerovigli or Firostefani, it was only with the help of the stubborn climbing artists, that these daring constructions were made possible. Antonis Vlachos has ten strong mules that work for him. He transports almost everything with them: stones, food or the typically blue paint for the church domes. Santorini is a tourist magnet and up to five cruise ships call in at the islands daily. However, there is no port, just a narrow, concrete quay. Without the tender boats, no guests would ever reach the shore.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: The contours of the Mediterranean have changed during the course of its history. Near Gibraltar, Africa was once connected to the European continent. When the land bridge at Gibraltar collapsed, the Mediterranean basin filled up again. The Suez Canal is today connected to the Red Sea. This route enables animals to reach the Mediterranean, where they cause problems.

programme.title: Inside New York

Er beherbergt eines der kritischsten Infrastruktursysteme der USA: sechs Containerterminals, die jeden Tag Millionen Kilos an Fracht ein- und ausladen. Dieses System wird von Tausenden von Arbeitnehmern getragen - von Schlepperkapitänen über die Küstenwache bis hin zu Hafenarbeitern.

Richard had recently been diagnosed with a brain tumour. The murder weapon, an Indian sword, is found close by and is discovered to have been stolen in a burglary at the vicarage. Barnaby and Troy set out to discover who would want to kill a dying man.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Nine years before, a series of women was strangled with a neck-tie and left naked in woodland on the edge of Midsomer Worthy. When a Brazilian woman who had recently arrived in the village is also found murdered in the same way within the woods, Barnaby comes up against a retired detective who couldn't solve the previous case, a tobacco company, family arguments and problematic evidence, before other bodies turn up in the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A slashed portrait of Jonathan Lowrie in the museum at Aspern Tallow brings Barnaby and Troy to investigate. They find themselves stepping back in time, dealing with a series of ghostly events, the death of elderly Marcus Lowriewho was found in the tomb of his ancestor, a mysterious escaped criminal, a therapist who isn't quite what she seems and a museum trustee with a hidden past. It is not long before the bodies start piling up and things begin to make sense.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Shortly after two groups of travellers arrive in the village of Martyr Warren, local magistrate Hector Bridges is killed with his own shotgun. Barnaby and Troy had to dissuade him from forcefully evicting the travellers with help from his army friends and learn Hector was a bully and disliked by many who knew him. The detectives have to unravel a tangle of relationships before they track down the culprit.

programme.desc: O primeiro Grand Cherokee fabricado sob o reinado da Fiat está pronto para nosso teste. A quarta geração deste clássico veículo todo-o-terreno parece muito mais elegante do que antes.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: É um dos seus primeiros destaques em 2012. O novo BMW One M Coupe do ex-piloto de carros de corrida Ralf Kelleners: o KS1 RS. 420 cavalos de potência e uma verdadeira besta na pista de corrida.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: A classe premium da Mercedes-Benz tem um novo filho. O "pequeno" S250 com motor de quatro cilindros precisa de tão pouco combustível que se poderia chamar este carro de "mealheiro".

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: James Dean teria sido um grande fã do novo Porsche Boxter, um verdadeiro carro esportivo de teto aberto. A Volkswagen apresenta o novo Passat Alltrack, um verdadeiro "allrounder".

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Para os fãs da Alfa, o Giulietta não é apenas um carro, é uma religião. Agora a Alfa Romeo nos surpreendeu com novos motores, uma nova caixa de velocidades e um pequeno lifting facial.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: No final dos anos 50, a Facel Vega Facellia foi projetada para competir com a Porsche e a Alfa Romeo e abrir um novo segmento de mercado para a jovem empresa francesa de carros de luxo.

programme.title: Maserati Quattroporte GTS
programme.desc: 1963, há mais de 50 anos, com o Quattroporte Maserati inventou uma nova categoria de veículos, o sedan esportivo. Este modelo GTS já é a sexta geração deste carro icônico.

programme.title: Porsche Cayenne E-Hybrid
programme.desc: A Porsche apresentou a última versão de seu luxuoso SUV Cayenne no sul da França. O E-Hybrid combina o melhor de dois mundos: é muito ágil, mas também pode dirigir curtas distâncias de forma puramente elétrica.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Estar um passo à frente do tempo sempre foi um pouco mais caro. Mas será o novo BMW i8 apenas um luxuoso e vanguardista transportador de tecnologia ou já pode ser considerado como um carro esportivo sério? Por que você deveria pagar o dobro do preço em comparação com o BMW M4? Por que você não deveria comprar um BMW M5 de boa aparência, que tem o mesmo preço, mas é mais funcional? Os supercarros revelam as respostas.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O Porsche 911 GTS é o mais recente modelo da icônica linha de carros esportivos 911. Com uma potência de 430 HP, ele fecha a lacuna entre o modelo S e o GT3. Os supercarros têm a chance de dar uma volta no novo Porsche 911 GTS na Califórnia. Além disso: O Roding Roadster é um carro esportivo leve da Baviera em pequena série e utiliza tecnologia da BMW sob seu capô.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Hoje em dia dificilmente há um fabricante de automóveis que não construa qualquer tipo de SUV. Três dos SUV mais esportivos do mercado são os Porsche Macan Turbo, Mercedes GLA 45 AMG e Audi RSQ3. Cada um deles vem com mais de 300 HP; eles estão bem preparados para qualquer temporada e têm ambições de serem carros esportivos. Supercarros descobre, se eles têm o que é preciso para ser um carro esportivo.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O Porsche Panamera Turbo S é o sedan mais dinâmico do mundo. Nenhum outro carro encontra o equilíbrio perfeito entre, por um lado, o deslizamento calmo e, por outro, o desempenho extremo. 570 hp, 3,8 segundos de zero a 100 km/h e uma velocidade máxima de 310 km/h são dados de desempenho impressionantes para este grande carro. Além disso: o Jaguar XJR com motor V8 de 550 cv e o Mercedes CLS 500.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: O luxo não significa necessariamente perda de tempo. Híbrido é uma das técnicas que promete menor consumo de combustível com um motor ainda potente. A Lexus é a pioneira na eletrificação de automóveis. Os supercarros conduzem o novo LS 600h, o BMW Active Hybrid 7 e o Porsche Panamera S E-Hybrid.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: A Silvretta Hochalpenstrasse na Áustria é o recreio ideal para os pacotes de potência leves Lotus Elise e Roding Roadster. Estes dois roadsters estão colados à rua e, portanto, muito divertidos de conduzir. E: o elegante mas ainda muito potente Porsche 911 Targa 4S.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Se as pessoas ouvirem o nome Aston Martin, imaginam aventuras James Bond, estilo britânico, performance e luxo. O modelo Vantage N430 da marca é um carro desportivo que faz os condutores e entusiastas sentirem a herança dos carros de corrida britânicos. Também: uma combinação de elegância e potência, o Bentley Continental GTC Speed com o seu motor W12 Twin Turbo.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Em 2014, a Mercedes-Benz apresentou o seu primeiro Plug-in Híbrido, o S500. Com um consumo médio declarado de 2,8 litros, o S500 foi o carro de luxo mais eficiente do mercado em termos de consumo de combustível. Também: quando se trata de Bentley, um motor V8 significa basicamente um down-sizing. Demos uma vista de olhos à versão Flying Spur da marca britânica com um motor mais pequeno. E: a 6ª geração Maserati Quattroporte.

programme.title: Volkswagen Touareg V6 TDI
programme.desc: A Volkswagen submeteu o Touareg a uma transformação radical. As esperanças são grandes: tem que vender em grande escala para que a administração possa restaurar a confiança das pessoas na marca Volkswagen.

programme.title: Jeep Wrangler - quarta geração
programme.desc: Em 2018, foi introduzida a quarta geração do Wrangler. Ela continha tecnologia de última geração, mas o visual robusto permaneceu o mesmo. A marca trabalha duro para manter esta silhueta desde o primeiro Jeep de sempre, o Willys MB.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: A Escalada de Pikes Peak Hill de 1987. Um tipo de corrida bastante diferente nas montanhas do Colorado, EUA. É única, fascinante e cheia de aventura.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: Desde 1934, o Grande Prêmio tem sido o campeonato mundial mais emocionante e fascinante do mundo. Com seus veículos de última geração, com a potência das maiores marcas, ela nunca deixa de impressionar seus espectadores.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.sub-title: Rallye Ano 1972 - Uma Historia de Sucesso Ford
programme.desc: O Campeonato Internacional de Fabricantes foi uma série de rallys de 1970-72. Fabricantes de automóveis como Porsche, Renault e Ford participaram, com a Ford tendo um ano de excepcional sucesso em 1972.

programme.title: Mercedes 300 SL 'Leve'
programme.desc: Um carro de corrida icônico e um dos únicos 29 já construídos! Acompanhamos o Mercedes 300 SL 'Leve' em sua estréia no Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Bentley Mulsanne EWB
programme.desc: A versão longa da Bentley Mulsanne é um excelente exemplo de uma limusine com chope. Com ela, a marca britânica de carros de luxo colocou a fasquia extremamente alta quando se trata de conforto automotivo.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Smart também ofereceu o seu icónico carro citadino com opção de descapotável. O Mini cabriolet é maior, não apenas debaixo do capô. Oferece espaço para quatro pessoas. Quando se trata de uma grande sensação de roadster, o Mazda MX-5 está no topo da lista. Demos uma vista de olhos mais atenta a estes três concorrentes de topo aberto.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: O Salão Automobilístico de Paris é o salão automobilístico mais antigo do mundo e dá uma visão do mundo automotivo. Em 2016, a Mercedes apresentou sua sub-marca "Generation EQ", e a Volkswagen anunciou a construção de 20 novos modelos eletrificados.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Para alguns, a forma de cupê tem um apelo mais sexy, mas por que alguém escolhe um cupê de duas portas como o Mercedes E400 em vez do CLS com quatro portas? Além disso: independentemente do preço diferente, a Volkswagen Arteon ainda desafia o CLS.

programme.title: Incrível Jaguar F-Type R Tuning: Arden AJ23
programme.desc: Um Jaguar que pode atacar o medo no mundo apenas com o seu rugido. Este Jaguar Arden-tuned F-Type R é um verdadeiro mau rapaz. Já tem uma verdadeira dentada na configuração padrão, mas o Arden é mais forte, mais alto e mais agressivo.

programme.title: Volvo S90
programme.desc: Parece mais esportivo do que se poderia esperar dos suecos. Os faróis traseiros emolduram a poderosa parte traseira. No interior, o Volvo S90 impressiona com os materiais mais finos e o couro macio da napa.

programme.title: Audi MTM S8 Talladega R
programme.desc: O Audi S8 Plus não é de forma alguma subestimado, mas é e permanece fiel à subestimação desta série de modelos. Aqueles que querem mais poder podem obter um impulso da MTM.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Ao ganhar o icônico Rally Dakar 13 vezes, o francês Stephane Peterhansel teve uma carreira bastante incomum quando mudou de motocicletas para carros e desfrutou de enorme sucesso com ambos os veículos.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Alois Ruf é o fundador de uma pequena, mas conhecida empresa fabricante de carros na Baviera, especializada em construir sua própria visão de carros super esportivos legais de rua sobre a fundação de carrocerias Porsche.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Dos anos 50 aos 70, Hans Herrmann ganhou fama como piloto de Fórmula 1 e de carros esportivos para fabricantes como Porsche, Mercedes-Benz e Maserati, que também ganhou as 24 Horas de Le Mans várias vezes.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: As pessoas a chamavam de "Rainha da Nordschleife". Sabine Schmitz foi uma piloto de corridas de sucesso antes de trabalhar como apresentadora para a televisão alemã e mais tarde para o famoso programa da BBC "Top Gear".

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Quando o fabricante britânico Land Rover decidiu terminar a sua produção do icónico Defensor após mais de 60 anos, era necessário determinar um sucessor. Visualmente, poderia ser modelado após o Discovery, cuja quinta geração é uma mistura de veículo todo-o-terreno e SUV de luxo. Também: o SsangYong Rexton, o Jeep Renegade e a nossa escolha dos 5 melhores veículos todo-o-terreno.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.sub-title: Alpina B5 Touring contra Jaguar XF Sportbrake
programme.desc: O Audi RS6 e o Mercedes E63 AMG são os dois melhores esportistas entre os vagões de estação. A BMW parece ter desistido da corrida, mas o afinador de alto desempenho Alpina surgiu com o B5 Twin Turbo, sua resposta baseada na BMW para a forte competição. Também: o ágil e confiável Skoda Octavia Combi. E: o Jaguar XF Sportbrake, um vagão de estação para individualistas.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Quem é o rei das caminhonetes fora da estrada? Os especialistas off-road da Delta 4x4 transformaram um Volkswagen Amarol em sua chamada Besta e desafiaram o especialista off-road da Toyota Alexander Wohlfarth em sua Toyota Hilux. Qual destas motorizadas 4x4 tem melhor preço em terrenos difíceis e ainda oferece adequação suficiente para o uso diário?

programme.title: Cadillac Escalade
programme.desc: O Cadillac Escalade a princípio parece um típico carro americano bastante carnudo, mas este luxuoso SUV é mais um gigante amável e gentil, que deve ser capaz de ganhar simpatia com sua clientela.

programme.title: Seat Alhambra
programme.desc: Embora o Seat Alhambra não pareça particularmente esportivo, mas quando testado por dois ciclistas profissionais, ele mostra que não deve ser subestimado.

programme.title: KIA Sorento
programme.desc: O Sorento é o principal veículo da linha de modelos da KIA. O fabricante coreano espera conquistar o mercado de SUV premium, oferecendo boa qualidade a um preço atrativo. O Sorento atende aos padrões de um veículo de primeira classe?

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.sub-title: Classicos alemaes sobre carros de corrida
programme.desc: Os Mercedes Silver Arrows estão entre os carros de corrida mais fascinantes de todos os tempos. A Jochen Mass conduz na estrada alpina Grossglockner. Também: o Porsche 550 RS Spyder começou um sucesso mundial. E: em 1980, a Audi criou uma sensação.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O Facel Vega Facellia pode ser um belo carro, mas não foi um sucesso devido a muitas dificuldades técnicas. Também: o lendário Citroen 2CV's, o Renault Alpine A110, e: um restaurador alemão colocou um clássico Bugatti Tipo 57 de volta à estrada.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O VW Tipo 166 Schwimmwagen é absolutamente único e, ao mesmo tempo, o verdadeiro allrounder. Também: na década de 1980, o Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 foi uma sensação. E: o jipe Willys. O carro levou os corações dos entusiastas do todo-o-terreno.

programme.title: Creme 21 Youngtimer Rally 2019
programme.desc: Bem-vindo à década de 1980, uma época em que havia apenas três cremes para a pele e três programas de televisão. No Oldtimer Creme 21, os amantes de carros podem sentir-se transportados de volta a essa época uma vez por ano.

programme.title: Lexus LS600h
programme.desc: A Lexus é pioneira na construção de veículos híbridos modernos. Em 2007, a marca premium da Toyota introduziu o LS 600h com uma combinação de acionamento elétrico e a combustão.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Neste episódio, convidamos você a testemunhar o progresso do motorista Uwe Nittle ao se preparar para a qualificação no Truck Grand Prix.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: O Desafio RCN é a derradeira experiência de condução da BMW. Fizemos também uma visita ao Devils Diner, o ponto de encontro interno da pista para os motoristas.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Após o término da corrida de 24 horas, deixamos o Nürburgring e nos mudamos para Büren, Alemanha, onde a empresa Raeder Motorsport está sediada. Eles são famosos pela tração dianteira com um grande desempenho que coloca uma grande potência na pista.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Os ruídos dos motores e exaustores geralmente dominam o Nürburgring, mas desta vez nos concentramos em algo um pouco mais silencioso. Que tal participar de um passeio de 15 milhas de bicicleta ao redor do ringue, ou talvez uma corrida de 16 milhas?

programme.title: Artega GT
programme.desc: De 2006 a 2012, a empresa alemã Artega produziu seu modelo de carro esportivo GT. Graças ao know-how de um antigo gerente da Porsche e da BMW, a Artega GT pôde ser fabricada em uma pequena série.

programme.title: Heróis de acrobacias
programme.desc: Ramazan, um especialista em artes marciais, cria uma luta coreografada envolvendo quatro duplos a brincar aos agentes secretos tentando apanhá-lo. Poderá Ramazan sair desta situação desagradável? Quem vai tirar um carro de uma forma espectacular? Descobre neste episódio de Stunt Heroes.

programme.title: Heróis de acrobacias
programme.desc: Nevoeiro, escuridão e um amontoado: É uma cena que pode ser vista frequentemente em auto-estradas e é uma cena que os Heróis das acrobacias da Action Concept querem recriar como parte de uma acrobacia com pessoas a arder, um bombeiro a chegar tarde ao local e um carro a voar pelo ar. É uma questão de mão-de-obra, coragem, confiança... e de timing perfeito.

programme.title: Heróis de acrobacias
programme.sub-title: Herois de acrobacias - El Ejercito Blanco
programme.desc: Os Heróis do Action Concept Stunt deixam sua sede e viajam para uma estação de esqui. Nas árvores de uma floresta próxima eles simulam o ataque de um exército de soldados todos vestidos de branco. Como parte desta espetacular proeza, eles querem explodir um carro e voar pelo ar.

programme.title: Toyota GT86 J-Sport
programme.desc: Com o Toyota GT 86 da J-Sport, é perceptível que as raízes da empresa estão nas corridas. O desejo dos fãs de dar ao racer japonês um poder significativamente maior, no entanto, não foi atendido.

programme.title: Porsche Cayman GT4
programme.desc: O Porsche Cayman GT4. Mais leve, mais potente e mais rápido do que nunca. O Porsche mostra o que é possível com este veículo, quando os rápidos tempos de volta estão no centro das atenções.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O Troféu Histórico na pista de corrida de Nürburgring apresentava carros clássicos de épocas passadas do automobilismo. Também: com o M3, a BMW trouxe a tecnologia dos carros de corrida para as ruas. Era um carro versátil, adequado para a cidade, o campo e a rodovia. E também deixou uma marca impressionante na DTM. E: em 1987, o Ford Sierra RS Cosworth ensinou a sua competição de corrida o significado do medo.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: 1964 marcou a incursão da Opel no mercado de classe de luxo e seu ataque à Mercedes-Benz quando a marca apresentou sua série KAD com o Kapitän, Almirante e Diplomat - uma gama de carros que oferecia design americano aliado à tecnologia alemã. Demos uma olhada em vários modelos desta época.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.sub-title: Conversiveis para uma viagem ao campo
programme.desc: O BMW 507 Roadster foi acarinhado por superestrelas como Elvis Presley. Hoje, o carro esportivo de 150 HP de 1955 é um dos clássicos mais valiosos de todos os tempos. Mais: siga os passos da marca Porsche em um 356 Cabrio.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Carros como o Ford GT 40, o Jaguar D-Type ou o Mercedes 300 SL fizeram história na pista de corrida e agora estão batendo recordes em leilão. Um 300 SL restaurado participará do rally de automóveis clássico Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Seguimos a restauração do único veículo de pesquisa Bayer K67, o primeiro carro totalmente em plástico do mundo, desenvolvido em 1967 pela gigante farmacêutica Bayer.

programme.title: Lancia Stratos HF
programme.desc: O Lancia Stratos com potência Ferrari, o ícone do rally dos anos 70.

programme.title: BMW 328 Schlüter
programme.desc: Se um carro chega em um trailer, seu valor é geralmente muito alto. O BMW 328 Schlüter original já é raro e caro. Mas este modelo é uma reconstrução e é absolutamente único.

programme.title: Father of Invention
programme.desc: After 8 years in prison, an inventor struggles to win over his estranged family and catch up with technology.

programme.title: Stan & Ollie
programme.desc: A look at the personal and profession lives of the popular comedic duo, Stan Laurel and Oliver Hardy.

programme.title: Employee Of The Month
programme.desc: Two Super Club workers vie for the "Employee of the Month" title and to win the heart of the hot new cashier.

programme.title: Dirty 30
programme.desc: Kate’s friends offer to throw a party for her 30th birthday. The celebration quickly spirals out of control.

programme.title: Barb and Star Go to Vista Del Mar
programme.desc: Two friends leave their Midwestern town and find themselves in over their heads with love and crime in Florida

programme.title: Seeking a Friend for the End of the World
programme.desc: As an asteroid nears Earth, a man decides to take a road trip to reunite with his high school sweetheart.

Yubiri a consecuencias de la lluvia no puede presentar su trabajo a Briggite y comienza a contarle a Wilker una historia que ella se había imaginado.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 180: Atraco y un Error Amoroso
programme.desc: Gerson sale por error con Cristina y Yuraima al mismo tiempo. Doroteo, María José, Paco y María Antonia sufren un atraco en el centro comercial.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 125: Betania se casa, Daniela enfurece
programme.desc: Betania está siendo chequeada por el Dr. Estrada. Le dice que la ve muy bien, muy animada y feliz. Betania le dice que está así porque al día siguiente se casaba y que estaba sumamente feliz ya que era su sueño de toda la vida y que había encontrado el hombre que le haría cumplir esos sueños. Luis Guillermo. El Dr. Estrada se extraña y pregunta que si es Luis Guillermo Anzola. Betania le dice que sí. El se queda extrañado ya que hasta ese momento pensaba que ese muchacho era el novio de Daniela. Robert le está comentando a Berta lo del matrimonio de Luis Guillermo y Betania. Berta se extraña y se asusta al pensar que haría Daniela al enterarse de eso. Daniela no se aguanta ella misma de la furia que tiene desde que Luis Guillermo rompió el compromiso con ella.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Adolfo toma el control de la junta directiva de la empresa y hace quedar mal a Leonardo y sus ideas. Luego explica un plan para cambiar la empresa y se retira. Adolfo se reúne con un amigo y juntos festejan que será fácil destruir la empresa de los Ferrándiz. Carlos Ernesto sospecha de las intenciones de Adolfo Casares y piensa en aliarse con su madre para descubrir quiénes son los socios de Adolfo. Trinidad es llevada a la mansión de los Ferrándiz y es atendida por Coromoto pero aparece Agustina y no le da lugar en la casa, luego llega Irene y ambas se ponen a discutir. Maribel le consigue a Irene un registro de las llamadas de Alejandra pero Irene le dice que eso es invadir la privacidad de la persona y lo rompe, luego llega Alejandra y esta sospecha algo.

programme.title: Episodio 17
programme.desc: Alejandro y Sol pasan un día juntos en una playa, hacen el amor por primera vez y Alejandro le propone fecha para su casarse dentro de un mes. Aída ha resultado embarazada de su ex marido y planea decir que el hijo es de Alejandro. Cuando Sol y Alejandro regresan a la casa de los Monserrat para darle la noticia a la familia, allí se encuentran con Reina y Aída. Aída, al oír la noticia, no puede evitar sugerir que ellos estuvieron juntos hace un día, pero Reina lo arregla con otra mentira.

programme.desc: Para o compulsivo jogador de Slipper Jackie Chan, existe apenas uma coisa mais aterrorizante do que os credores o som do choro de um bebê. Mas e se um bebê se transformase no salvador de suas dívidas? Sua fobia por fraldas, mamadeiras e canções de ninar desapareceria? Essa oportunidade surge quando, junto com seu senhorio e o oportunista Octopus, seqüestra BB, o neto de um magnata. Mas sem saber, eles frustram os planos da tríade. Assim que descobrem que a tríade está no seu encalço, eles, com a ajuda da doce enfermeira Melody, da esposa do senhorio louco por bebês e Pat Yin, fã adolescente de Octopus. Slipper resolve transformar o bebê refém em seu protegido. Encurralados pelos policiais e perseguidos por gângsteres perigosos, este trio embarca numa arrepiante, perigosa e delirantemente engraçada fuga para colocar BB de volta em seu berço são e salvo.

Ele está no auge de sua carreira quando ele e sua parceira, Corinne, são coroados os vencedores inesperados do Campeonato Mundial de Dança Swing. Enquanto a multidão vibra e a celebração começa, Jake parece inquieto. Será que ele realmente merecia ganhar?

programme.title: Siga seu coração

programme.title: Carol
programme.desc: Duas mulheres de origens diferentes começam uma relação na década de 1950. Carol é casada, mas seu casamento está morto há muito tempo. Ela quer um divórcio, mas o marido está tentando desesperadamente manter as aparências. Quando Carol (Cate Blanchett) e Teresa (Mia Wasikowska) se apaixonam, o marido de Carol inicia o processo para obter a custódia total de seu filho. Seu marido tenta usar a homosexualidade de Carol no tribunal contra ela e lhe proíbe de ver sua filha por pelo menos 3 meses em uma tentativa de vingança

programme.title: Suite Francesa
programme.desc: França, 1940. Enquanto espera por notícias do marido, um prisioneiro de guerra, a bela Lucile leva uma vida reprimida com sua sogra controladora. Mas em breve, um regimento de soldados germânicos instalados nas casas dos camponeses. No inicio, Lucile tenta ignorar Bruno, o refinado oficial alemão que estava com elas, mas depois, um amor forte atrai-los e leva-os a tragédia da guerra.

programme.title: A Verdadeira História de Ned Kelly
programme.desc: Inspirado no best-seller de Peter Carey, este filme coloca em questão toda a mitologia criada ao redor do mito sobre a vida de Ned Kelly, observando o passado de violência de toda uma sociedade. Acompanhamos a juventude de Ned e observamos sua vida até o final, percebendo, sob a ótica do protagonista, o quanto é distorcida a fina linha que separa o certo do errado. As motivações de Kelly são reveladas e as tragédias em torno de sua gangue são mostradas de forma intensa e poderosa, a começar pelo amor de uma mãe por seu filho.

programme.title: Tráfico de Mulheres
programme.desc: Nesta história inspirada em personagens reais, três garotas dos EUA, Nigéria e Índia são traficadas por meio de uma elaborada rede global e escravizadas em um bordel no Texas, e devem juntas tentar uma fuga ousada para retomar sua liberdade.

programme.title: Código da Máfia
programme.desc: Mike acaba de sair da prisão e aceita fazer um último serviço com seu irmão para poder se livrar do mundo do crime e cuidar de sua filha. Ele logo descobrirá que a justiça das ruas é muito pior que tudo o que passou na prisão.

programme.title: O Justiceiro
programme.desc: Mestre em artes marciais e lutador, Kung Wei, vive numa casa humilde, com a esposa que está muito doente e com Johnny, seu filho que o adora e segue seus ensinamentos morais e de artes marciais. Kung Wei, é "recrutado" sigilosamente pela polícia, para disfarçado, desmantelar uma quadrilha em Hong Kong. Enquanto trabalhava com outra identidade, seu filho sofria com seus colegas que chamavam o pai de "bandido"; pois, a ele imputavam um crime. Neste meio tempo, sua esposa morre. Antes de morrer, ela confia a guarda do pequeno Johnny, ao policial que "investigava" Kung, supondo que se marido fosse um bandido perigoso. O mestre Kung Wei, terá que lutar muito nessa missão!

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.sub-title: The tasty ancient recipies from Abruzzo
programme.desc: Abruzzo’s ancient recipes have remained unchanged, with simple and fresh ingredients used creatively for maximum effect. Silvia meets with some distant cousins living in Australia and they spend the afternoon cooking one of the Abruzzo - region’s most traditional soups.

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: Get the basics right today with Kirsten and her recipe for chocolate lashes and homemade chocolate chips. Then learn the tricks to two Australian classic favourites with a Lamington Cake and Chocolate Caramel Slice.

programme.desc: It’s fright night! Our contestants must create terrifying yet tasty desserts. From edible skulls to bleeding apples, the creations will send chills up your spine.

programme.title: UpRooted With Sarah Sharratt
programme.desc: Host Sarah Sharratt dives into the French love of oysters. She visits the windswept Atlanic coast, with its epic sand dunes, breathtaking views, and famous oyster farms. Sarah gets a hands-on lesson in oyster harvesting and places a bid at the famous fish auction in Arcachon. A stop in at St. Emilion to pick up some white wine is the last stop before Sarah heads home to prepare a sea-inspired meal.

programme.title: Jamie's Quick & Easy Food
programme.desc: Jamie starts by cooking up his Tikka Chicken - it’s the quickest roast you’ll ever make. Next, there’s a vibrant carrot and grain salad you can whip up in minutes, and super speedy crab spaghetti—a luxurious and uncomplicated date night dinner.

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Diana seeks inspiration from her Malaysian roots. Jacob Leung shares his tips to perfect fried rice at home . Diana is joined by her cousin, Karen Chan, as they explore the traditional flavours used in Nonya cooking. Diana prepares her sweet and spicy dish inspired by the popular Mamak Stalls where young adults buy delicious and affordable food.

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Diana prepares an Indonesian street food favourite ‘Perkedel Jagung’- crispy, deep fried corn fritters. Mike Reid (chef) joins Diana to share his recipe for a popular Indonesian dish, ‘Sate Babi.’ Jerry Mai (chef) then showcases Indonesian spices with her ‘Balinese Grilled Chicken & Coconut Sambal.’ Diana finishes the theme with a traditional sweet dessert ‘Bubur Sumsum- Coconut Rice Porridge.’

programme.title: Quest For Love
programme.desc: Mackenzie travels to Costa Rica for work. Her best friend Ethan comes along to get romantic inspiration for his action /adventure novel. Mackenzie has loved Ethan for a long time, but he only sees her as a friend--until a tourist named Lucas makes Ethan see Mackenzie in a new light.

programme.title: Retreat to Paradise
programme.desc: Ellie tends to the injured and cantankerous Jordan as he heals from a shoulder injury. Though he struggles to learn to use his arm again, his attitude leaves Ellie wanting to leave him in his misery. But as they get to know each other more, Jordan starts to see Ellie is exactly who he wants in his life, and hopes Ellie feels the same way.

programme.title: Scents and Sensibility
programme.desc: In this modern adaptation of Jane Austen’s Sense and Sensibility, Elinor and Marianne find themselves penniless after their father’s fortune is taken away. As they look for ways to pay the bills, they encounter people who judge them and try to keep them down in the dumps. Add falling in love into the mix, and determining whom to trust becomes a mine field. Can the sisters find a balance between relying on their hearts and using good sense without losing everything they hold dear?

programme.title: Love Finds You In Valentine
programme.desc: What can a California girl do with a few dusty acres of land in rural Nebraska? So Kennedy Blaine wonders after she inherits a ranch in the small town of Valentine, Nebraska. As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God’s protection and Derek’s assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek’s own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: Love, Alaska
programme.desc: When two childhood friends are reunited through a generous inheritance that bestows far more on their broken hearts than they bargained for - a second chance at love.

programme.title: For the Love of Chocolate
programme.desc: Preparing for the annual Masters of Chocolate Festival, Aria's plans get rattled when she loses her partner shortly before the competition. However, a dashing single father soon steps in to help Aria find the winning ingredient.

programme.title: A Taste of Tuscany
programme.desc: April is a health chef guru who goes to Italy to learn how to incorporate the country’s rich culture of food in her own recipes. April finds new joy and freedom in life and cooking – and also love.

programme.title: An Hour Behind
programme.desc: When Trish Harper is late for a blind date due to Daylight Savings time, she mistakenly meets Parker, a thoughtful paramedic. But even though there's a spark between them, when she discovers her error she keeps him at arms-length, focusing instead on her thriving bakery. But ever so slowly, she begins to fall in love...

programme.title: Romance on the Ranch
programme.desc: When her truck breaks down in the mid-west, Sara is invited to park her camper on a family ranch while her truck is repaired. She meets two brothers, who are as different as night and day. The brothers are instantly smitten with Sara and soon she begins to have feelings for them both. The last thing Sara expected to find was romance on the ranch.

programme.title: Love in Focus
programme.desc: When the hit show actress Jenna Wilde stars in suddenly gets cancelled, the press start circling. To escape the chaos Jenna retreats to a snowy cabin in the mountains. Unexpectedly, she must share this peaceful place with a rude and rugged nature photographer Chris Dixon. Their coolness towards each other starts to thaw when Chris helps Jenna audition for other shows.

programme.title: Helping Hands Garage
programme.desc: Everyone remembers their childhood vehicle. Well Mackie found her dad’s vintage F100 in terrible condition and didn’t know what to do. After the truck sat idle for years, the Helping Hands crew brings new life into the classic truck so Mackie can hear the engine rev again.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.sub-title: Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Big Time Motorcycle Auction

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn?

Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Legendary drag racer Don “The Snake” Prudhomme proves he is no stranger to the thrill of racing rivalry. Prudhomme’s career and subsequent competition with driver Tom “The Mongoose” McEwan earned the pair an unforgettable imprint on American pop culture. Legions of kids in the 60’s and 70’s flocked to the shelves for Snake and Mongoose Matchbox cars which helped make drag racing an undisputable American pastime. programme.title: AmeriCarna

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Exploring Japanese Street Food and Local Surfing Spots | DIRT Japan: Kyushu"
programme.desc: "Hope you're hungry. In this episode, come along as we eat our weight in sushi and ramen, meet nori farmers and wagyu ranchers, and make some new surfing buddies along the way. P.S. if you're hungry for more Japan content, stay tuned for our next two episodes. - In this episode of DIRT, the crew road tripped around Kyushu. The food culture in Kyushu dates back to the emperors of Japan, and the Black Current off the eastern shore has shaped the island's cuisine for centuries. The DIRT team followed that current up the coastline, surfing with new friends and tasting new flavors. And with each stop, we learned even more about how the traditions we keep can honor thousands of years of knowledge—and point the way to the future."

We learn about Carolina Skiffs and visit Grady-White in Greenville, then meet some professional boat cinematographers and local custom Carolina sport fishing yacht dealers. Finally we stop in Washington to reminisce about the early days of powerboat racing with champion Reggie Fountain, who regales viewers with tales of beating Don Johnson, Kurt Russell, Al Copeland and Chuck Norris while setting speed records and capturing the title of the fastest V-bottom boat in the world. From go-fast speed boats to family cruising we see some of what makes North Carolina’s storied boating culture unique and special.

Wind, shifting conditions, and sharp eyes keep things interesting as they cover ground and look for the right opportunity. Every move matters, and nothing comes easy.

programme.desc: Billy Yargus is hunting Eastern's in Missouri and shares some tips and techniques for calling turkeys in open country. Some great call sequences on display as 4 big gobblers make their way to Billy across a wide open field.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
